active_continuity: Go Jun's blind loyalty to Lee Jungryong led him to defy Lee's order to avoid a clash with the Peace Guild.
Go Jun attacked Taekyung with his full strength and was defeated by a single counterblow, suffering severe internal injuries and losing consciousness.
Taekyung warned Lee Jungryong through Go Jun that no one can touch the Peace Guild while Taekyung is alive.
Lee Woojoong and more than two hundred Association Hunters witnessed the defeat and agreed to suppress or deny their memories of the incident.
An Ares Guild team leader is responsible for reporting Go Jun's defeat and Taekyung's warning to Lee Jungryong.
Taekyung regards the conflict with Ares as a war without a lasting truce and will remain vigilant.
The Peace Guild members are demanding an explanation for Taekyung's disappearance and return.
open_questions: How will Lee Jungryong respond to Go Jun's defeat and Taekyung's warning?
temporary_decisions: Render 열화 in Taekyung's lineage declaration as “the Blazing Flame.”
Render 애송아 as “brat” in Go Jun's internal address.
